CustomField.description: Displays concatenated provider name, and if targeted by the current user, a star at the end. Used in the Log a Visit flow to show which additional providers are targeted by the current user.
CustomField.formula: IF( My_Zoned_Provider__c, Provider__r.FirstName & " " & Provider__r.MiddleName & " " & Provider__r.LastName & " " & Provider__r.Suffix & " " & TEXT(Provider__r.Credentials__c) & IMAGE("https://orlandohealth--c.vf.force.com/resource/1718307189000/GraphicsPackNew/silk/16/silk/star.png", "STAR"), Provider__r.FirstName & " " & Provider__r.MiddleName & " " & Provider__r.LastName & " " & Provider__r.Suffix & " " & TEXT(Provider__r.Credentials__c) )
CustomField.label: Provider Name Zoned
